newsitem.title: FINLAND: Konecranes elaborates view on Jan-Apr.
newsitem.headline: Konecranes elaborates view on Jan-Apr.

text.p: Finnish industrial cranes maker KCI Konecranes said on Wednesday analysts forecasting its January-April profit should note that in the near past, about 15 percent of the full-year total has come in that period.
"In the near past, approximately 15 percent of profit before taxes is coming in the first tertial," chief financial officer Eero Odelma told Reuters.

He was elaborating on a statement issued by Konecranes that analysts had not fully understood the "deep seasonality of KCI Konecranes' revenue and profit accumulation". The statement said analysts' full-year outlook was in line with its own.
Analysts polled by Reuters had been looking for full-year 1997 profit for Konecranes at around 250 million markka.
Before Konecranes' statement, their first-tertial assumptions had been for a profit around 46 million markka, an increase of almost 30 percent on 36.2 million markka in the year-ago period.
Konecranes' full-year profit before extras and tax in 1996 was 208 million markka.
Odelma declined to comment on specific figures, but said the year-ago figure -- about 17 percent of the full-year total -- had also been boosted by special factors.
